name: PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk
summary: PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk owns and operates European themed D'Monaco restaurant in Indonesia. Its D'Monaco restaurant offers wedding reception, birthday celebration, anniversary, pre-wedding photoshoot, bridal shower, board and corporate meeting, arisan, fashion show, fine dining, and other social events. The company also operates Sofia residence, which offers residences with European taste; and owns and operates Insom lounges.
